additional_info.subject: RE: ID0438692-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / S8 170003981] Left charging point is offline CRM:02832000240
additional_info.body:
Dear Michael Frenger,
I hope this message finds you well.
I wanted to inform you that charger outlet was unavailable due to a COAP error.
The COAP error you’ve encountered is due to a  interruption in internal communication between the SiC D and the SECC. Please rest assured that this is a temporary issue,charger outlet was temporarily unavailable.The issue has been resolved after reboot, Outlet is available now.
The charger is now healthy, with no active error flags, and all outlets are available.
Could you kindly verify from your side and confirm that everything is functioning as expected?
If issue persists or and outlet goes outoforder then we will proceed with SECC update.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
